interpretive_leap: The oriented difference between a braid word and its reverse supplies the role normally assigned to multiplication by the imaginary unit on one nontrivial finite history sector.
ordinary_explanation: Every oriented involutive Yang-Baxter/S3 action has the same order-three group-algebra mechanism on its standard sectors; the ordinary flip control confirms that this mechanism is not distinctive to the pointed-Braid event table.
falsifier_for_next_stage: A source-only probability functional on the reconstructed complex sector that is not uniquely the normalized squared norm, or the need to insert a complex state, trace state, q phase, noncontextual probability axiom, or fitted measure by hand.
claim_ceiling: BGCE458 closes only the existence of a source-oriented finite complex kinematic sector: the actual three-history pointed-Braid event action has a rank-72 real sector with exact J^2=-I after normalization and therefore complex dimension 36 with positive counting norm. It does not derive the full M_(5^n)(C) tower, a unique complex structure on every sector, a source-selected state, arbitrary observables, tensor composition, interference probabilities, the Born rule, dynamics, QFT, empirical quantum mechanics, confirmation, Level 3 or Official SIEL adoption. The ordinary flip control also passes, so pointed-Braid specificity is not established.
